Found 2 CRITICAL frontend bugs: (1) COOGI DNA TAG cart items blocked at /checkout with 'Not available for online checkout yet' (same slug-missing pattern as Parabola Heritage in iter 35), (2) OVATION is missing entirely from /shop grid even though products.js defines it with price_range 'From $225 USD'.

ui_bugs.issue: After add-to-cart for COOGI DNA TAG, /checkout shows 'Not available for online checkout yet — please remove to continue.' and PAY WITH CARD stays disabled. Root cause: CoogiDnaTagPage.jsx onAddToCart (line ~179) does NOT set `slug` on the cart line. CartContext stores `slug: product.slug` (undefined) and `product_id: product.id` where id = `coogi-dna-tag-sand[-engraved]`. Checkout.jsx baseSlug = i.slug||i.product_id = 'coogi-dna-tag-sand-engraved', which is NOT in SUPPORTED_SLUGS (which contains the base 'coogi-dna-tag'). Fix: add `slug: 'coogi-dna-tag'` to the product object passed to handleAddToCart, OR add `baseSlug` normalisation in Checkout.jsx that strips tier/variant suffixes.

OVATION card is MISSING from /shop (looked under ALL, SIGNATURE, after full scroll — 50 shop-card-price-* testids rendered but none for ovation; body text does not contain 'OVATION'). products.js defines ovation with price_range 'From $225 USD', collection 'signature', isFeatured:true. Spec required /shop to show OVATION card From $225 USD. Likely a filter/visibility rule or seed collection is dropping it.

Minor: after adding SAND engraved, clicking data-testid='coogi-acquire-variant-snow' and clicking Add produced a second cart line still labeled 'Sand · 10K Rose Gold $8,500' instead of 'Snow · 10K White Gold'. Prices still display correctly on the PDP, so this may be a re-render edge case rather than a state bug. Needs owner-visible repro.

rca of the issue:
COOGI checkout block — RCA identical to iter 35's Parabola Heritage bug but on a different page. CoogiDnaTagPage.jsx:179 passes a product object WITHOUT a `slug` field. CartContext.jsx stores `slug: product.slug` → undefined and `product_id: product.id` where product.id = 'coogi-dna-tag-sand-engraved' (per CoogiDnaTagPage.jsx:181). Checkout.jsx:66-68 derives baseSlug = i.slug||i.product_id → 'coogi-dna-tag-sand-engraved'. SUPPORTED_SLUGS has only the base 'coogi-dna-tag' → isSupportedItem returns false → unsupported banner + disabled Pay. Reproduction: /coogi-dna-tag → tick engraving → Add to Cart → /checkout → orange banner. Fix: on line 180 add `slug: 'coogi-dna-tag',` alongside `productKey: 'coogiDnaTag'`.

OVATION missing from /shop — RCA pending; data entry in /app/frontend/src/data/products.js:3414 looks correct (isFeatured:true, inventory_count:100, collection:'signature', audience includes gentlemens-club and ladies). Shop renders 50 cards but no ovation testid and no 'OVATION' body text. Likely culprits: duplicate id/slug collision (grep shows two 'ovation' slug entries at lines 671 and 3417 in products.js — dedupe may drop the second), or an audience/visibility filter in ShopDropPage. Investigate the dedupe/filter logic in ShopDropPage.jsx.
